Holds the VCS Parameters that do not fit in the page 10h Staged Control Set 0 register space (bytes 153-175): the page 10h/11h space is filled first (§ 4.4), and in this revision modules shall keep the CMIS base Control Set layout (§ 4.5), so the in-page space carries the CMIS base parameters and every additionally advertised read-write VCS Parameter begins here, in VCS Descriptor advertisement order, with media-interface parameters (PropertyFlags InterfaceType = 1b) after all host-interface parameters (§ 4.8.1). The layout inside this space is module-advertised: each parameter's offset is computed from the accumulated MemoryLength attributes of the advertised VCS Descriptor, and a VCS Parameter must be fully contained within a page (§ 4.4), so individual parameter offsets and lengths inside this space are not recorded. Register formats per parameter are recorded in the CmisVcsParameterId enum. |

Present when the module supports a second Staged Control Set (CMIS base optional). Mirrors the Staged Control Set 0 overflow content: read-write VCS parameters keep the same register offsets in every Control Set (§ 4.4). As with the Staged Control Set 0 overflow space, the layout is module-advertised and individual parameter offsets inside this space are not recorded; register formats per parameter are recorded in the CmisVcsParameterId enum. |
